note: THE STAFF RENAMED THE GATES BUT LEFT TWO THINGS POINTING AT THE OLD ONES, AND ONE OF THEM BREAKS UNMERGED WORKTREES OUTRIGHT. Found absorbing 66 commits of main into campaign/the-retelling. (1) WORKTREES RUN MAINS GIT HOOKS BUT THEIR OWN MAKEFILE. main pre-commit now calls make gate-commit; an unmerged worktree branch has no such target, so every commit there dies with no rule to make target gate-commit and the failure names the hook, not the cause. (2) cli/tests/heavy_tier.rs line 64 still holds the canonical heavy-tier ignore reason verbatim, and that string still ends deferred from the commit gate to make gate-full. make gate-full is now a refusing signpost that exits non-zero. That is exactly what a verbatim ratchet guarantees and exactly why it cannot notice. The same string also still claims minutes for a battery measured at 4.31 s. THE GENERAL SHAPE WORTH KEEPING: a ratchet that enforces sameness cannot detect that the shared value went stale, so renaming a make target needs a grep for the target name across enforcement constants, not just across callers.
